source: Minchat Shai on Exod 16:12 (the printed Masorah corrected; Lekach Tov)
claim_en: shamati et TELUNOT bene yisrael ('I have heard the MURMURINGS of the sons of Israel'): the murmurings-word in a spelling with NO TWIN — full first vav, lean second — and MS rules the printed Masorah's note ('2 written so') AN ERROR: 'it means NONE IS LIKE IT' (the census verifies: the exact skeleton stands ONCE in the Torah, checked); Lekach Tov on the lean letter: 'they were being DIMINISHED FROM THEIR MERITS'; and the same midrash's other face carried whole: 'all the complaints are as ONE COMPLAINT to Me — and though they murmur, THEY ARE MY SONS: sons of My beloved, sons of Abraham, sons of Isaac bound for My name': the verse where the Name reports the murmuring aloud spells the word as nothing else in the Torah — and the tradition reads the missing letter as the murmurers' thinning merit, and the verse's own frame as the Father's patience.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 16:30 (the Ramah's rule; the lean-list of parashat Bo)
claim_en: va-yishbetu ha-am ba-yom HA-SHEVII ('and the people rested on the SEVENTH day'): the seventh-word written LEAN — and the Ramah's rule verified EXACT: 'every seventh in the Torah is written full-yod EXCEPT THREE' — and the census finds exactly the three: the leaven-removal day (12:15, 'on the FIRST day you shall remove leaven... whoever eats leaven from the first day to the SEVENTH'), THE FIRST HUMAN SABBATH here (16:30), and the JUBILEE'S HORN (Lev 25:9, 'in the SEVENTH month... you shall sound the shofar'): the Torah's three thin sevenths — the day the leaven goes, the day the people first rest, and the day liberty is blown — one lean skeleton for the corpus's three great cessations (checked, 3/3).

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 16:13 (the pair); Minchat Shai on 16:13 (the Ramah; Yoma)
claim_en: va-taal HA-SELAV ('and the QUAIL came up'): the quail-word stands exactly TWICE in the Torah (checked): the supper of Sin here — and KIVROT-HATTAAVA ('and they gathered the quail,' Num 11:32, the graves of craving): the Kitzur — 'here too they gathered MUCH of it, but it CEASED — and so they went back and murmured over it' (the second station read back into the first: one bird, the gift and the grave); the word LEAN-yod in all precise books (MS citing the Ramah's explicit rule for both stations — against the Chizkuni); and the Talmud's reading carried (MS from Yoma): 'written slav, read SLAV with the soft letter — the righteous eat it IN PEACE (shalva); the wicked eat it and it is THORNS (silon) to them': one bird spelled between serenity and thorn — the manna-chapter's flesh-course filed with its own moral pointing.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 16:20 (the left-over pair; the three liftings); Minchat Shai on 16:20
claim_en: va-YOTIRU anashim mimenu ad-boqer va-YARUM tolaim ('and men LEFT OVER of it till morning — and it BRED worms'): the left-over form Torah-UNIQUE (checked), its Scripture-twin ELISHA'S BREAD ('and they ate AND LEFT OVER, according to the word of the LORD,' 2 Kgs 4:44) — the Kitzur: 'there they left over BY the word and a BLESSING was sent into it; here they left over AGAINST the word and a CURSE was sent into it' (one verb, the obedient surplus and the hoarded rot); and the lifting-word beside it carries the Kitzur's three (named): the worms LIFTED here, the GLORY LIFTED from the cherub (Ezekiel), and the HEART LIFTED (pride) — 'whoever's heart lifts, it will lift WORMS: be very, very lowly of spirit, for the hope of man is the worm' — with MS's letter-crown verified: the resh's vowel THREE DOTS (checked in-token), 'and in our Masorah: NONE OTHER' — the grammarian's reason: TO DISTINGUISH IT from va-yaram of the GLORY (Ezek 10:4): the worm-lift and the glory-lift held apart by one vowel.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 16:24 (the worm-pair)
claim_en: ve-RIMA lo-hayta bo ('and no WORM was in it'): the worm-word Torah-UNIQUE here (checked), its Scripture-twin JOB'S GRAVE ('together they lie in the dust, AND THE WORM COVERS THEM,' Job 21:26) — the Kitzur: 'the worm has NO POWER over the Sabbath[-kept manna], and the worm has no power over the manna-eaters — as is taught in the chapter The-Seller-of-the-Ship': the Sabbath surplus that would not rot against the weekday surplus that bred worms one verse-pair back (16:20 vs 16:24 — the same hoard, cursed on Friday's eve-of-doubt and blessed on the Sabbath's eve-of-command); the machine notes the tradition's ledger: what decides between worm and keeping is not the manna but the word it was kept by.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 16:14 (the cipher)
claim_en: daq MECHUSPAS ('a fine FLAKE-LIKE thing'): the flake-word an absolute Torah-hapax (checked — the word appears once in the language), and the Kitzur counts its letters: MECHUSPAS = 248 (asserted at the build) — 'for the manna was ABSORBED IN THE 248 LIMBS' (the traditional count of the body's members): the bread with no waste, its one-time word carrying the body's own number — the corpus files the cipher-class: the hapax that describes the manna's look encodes the tradition's account of where it went.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 16:16 (the alphabet), 16:4 (the manna-eaters' Torah), 16:5 (the double)
claim_en: ze ha-davar asher tziva YHWH: LIQTU... omer LA-GULGOLET ('this is the thing the LORD commanded: GATHER... an omer A HEAD'): the Kitzur — 'in this verse is THE WHOLE ALPHABET (asserted at the build: all twenty-two letters stand in 16:16), to tell you: WHOEVER UPHOLDS THE TORAH, the Holy One summons him his sustenance WITHOUT TOIL, like the eaters of the manna'; the doctrine's other head at the test-verse (16:4, anasenu ha-yelekh be-torati): 'THE TORAH WAS GIVEN ONLY TO THE EATERS OF THE MANNA' (the freed table as the Torah's precondition); and the double-verse (16:5, ve-haya MISHNE): 'everything of the Sabbath is DOUBLE: two lambs, two loaves, two lights, REMEMBER and KEEP' — the omer-command's verse carrying every letter the Torah is written with: the ration-law as the alphabet's own showcase.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 16:32 (the initials)
claim_en: LEMAAN YIRU ET HA-LECHEM ('THAT THEY MAY SEE THE BREAD which I fed you in the wilderness'): the four words' INITIAL LETTERS are the letters of ELIJAH (checked: the initials of lemaan yiru et ha-lechem = the letters of Eliyahu's lean spelling) — the Kitzur: 'to say it shall be KEPT UNTIL ELIJAH COMES': the keepsake-jar's purpose-clause signing, in its own first letters, the name of the herald at history's far end — the corpus files the arc the tradition draws: the bread kept for the generations addressed to the prophet who has not yet been born.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 16:23 (the order of the rest-words)
claim_en: SHABBATON shabbat-QODESH la-YHWH machar ('a SOLEMN REST, a HOLY SABBATH to the LORD, tomorrow'): the rest-word-before-Sabbath order stands here UNIQUELY (checked: the only shabbaton-then-shabbat adjacency in the Torah) — and in Vayaqhel the order REVERSES (35:2, 'holy... a sabbath of solemn rest'): the Kitzur — 'to teach that WE ADD FROM THE WEEKDAY ONTO THE HOLY both AT ITS ENTRY AND AT ITS EXIT: rest is needed before the core holiness comes, and after it leaves' (the two verses' word-orders as the two fences of the day — the tailor's needle put down before dark, the Sabbath's bathhouse not enjoyed after); the first Sabbath-law in the corpus arriving with its margins already drawn.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 16:29 (the three go-nots)
claim_en: shevu ish tachtav AL-YETZE ish mi-meqomo ba-yom ha-shevii ('sit every man in his place; LET NO MAN GO OUT of his place on the seventh day'): the let-none-go-out adjacency Torah-UNIQUE (checked), and the Kitzur runs the Masorah's three (named): 'let no man go out OF HIS PLACE — beyond FOUR CUBITS; let no FUGITIVE go out OF THE CITY (1 Kgs 20 read to the Sabbath-LIMIT); COME, STRIKE THEM, LET NO MAN GO OUT — a hint that the COURT flogs for Sabbath-boundary breaches, from the Torah': the corpus's first spatial law — rest legislated as geometry (sit, place, limit) — filed with the chain's own three-court reading of where the boundary-law binds.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 16:1 (the cipher); Minchat Shai on 16:1 (the spelling-rule)
claim_en: el-midbar-SIN ('to the wilderness of SIN'): the desert's name counts THE BUSH (asserted at the build: SIN = HA-SNEH, 120 = 120 — the Kitzur: the wilderness named for the thornbush of the calling), 'and it is called SINAI for the TEN utterances given on it' (the yod — ten — added to Sin makes Sinai: the mountain's name read as the desert's plus its own commandments); the station-word's Torah-census exact (checked, four: the arrival here, the departure 17:1, and the itinerary's pair Num 33:11-12); and MS's spelling-law over the whole file: 'every SIN with the samekh is written FULL, and every TZIN with the tzadi is written LEAN' — two deserts, two letters, two skeletal laws: the geography kept straight by orthography.

source: Kitzur Baal HaTurim on Exod 16:33 (the rest-pair); 16:36 (the juxtaposition)
claim_en: qach TZINTZENET achat ('take ONE JAR'): the jar-word an absolute Torah-hapax (checked) — the vessel that outlives its era named once, like its contents' look (16:14's hapax); VE-HANACH oto lifne YHWH — 'and LAY IT before the LORD': the lay-word's Masorah-pair named — GIDEON'S ROCK ('lay them on this rock,' Judg 6:20, where the fire consumed the meal of itself): the Kitzur — 'as there it was consumed of itself, so the manna was ABSORBED IN THE LIMBS and consumed of itself' (the laid-down offering that needs no digestion and no altar — one verb for the two self-consuming meals); and the omer-gloss verse's juxtaposition read (16:36 beside the manna-chapter): 'a hint that they would eat the manna UNTIL THEY OFFERED THE OMER' (the measure-word naming the offering whose arrival ends the manna, Josh 5 named): the chapter closes by weighing its miracle in the unit of its own expiry.

source: Minchat Shai on Exod 16 (the letter-file); Kitzur on 16:7/3/10
claim_en: The chapter's letter-file: KOL-ADAT (16:2) — the kaf DAGESHED (checked in-token: the guard-class dagesh after an open vowel again); the murmur-verb DUAL-WRITTEN twice in the chapter — written vilinu, READ va-yilonu (16:2), written talonu, READ talinu (16:7): the corpus's murmuring arrives in ketiv-and-qere, spelled one way and voiced another (the adjacent-token convention, gen_59 precedent); TELUNOT's nun dageshed for the swallowed rest-letter (16:12, the Mikhlol cited); LA-GULGOLET — BOTH gimels dageshed (16:16, checked at the build); lo hedif / lo hechsir with NO lengthener in either he (16:18); VE-NAMAS closing 16:21 in the pausal long vowel (MS walking the grammarians' dispute — the Levita's tradition of the short vowel against 'all our books,' Ibn Ezra and the Mikhlol with the long: dual-tracked as a grammarians' divergence, the stream standing); KE-ZERA pointed by the Chizkuni (16:31); and the PRINTED-AUTHORITY file gains a station: 'books that write ET ha-shabbat (16:29) are IN ERROR' (MS — the object-marker some presses added to the Sabbath-giving verse, struck); the Scripture-files named from the Kitzur: BE-SHAM'O three ('in distress and justly murmuring — He heard; the self-blesser at peace — He will not hear'), LA-SOVA four ('even in Egypt He summoned their fill — fish free of charge'), and the clouds by AARON'S MERIT (16:10 — 'as AARON spoke... the glory appeared in the cloud').
